notes: §1985:XIV.3.5.2 prints RECEIVE cd-name-1 {MESSAGE | SEGMENT} INTO identifier-1 [NO DATA imperative-statement-1] [WITH DATA imperative-statement-2] [END-RECEIVE]. CobolCommunication.g4#communicationReceiveStatement parses exactly that shape in that order (WITH optional, DATA required), CommunicationBinder#BindReceive binds it, the edition pass accepts it at 85 (communication-facility-removed-2014) and refuses the 2023 RECEIVE FROM..GIVING form (VisitMessagingReceiveStatement, COBOL0900). Probes at --std 85: 2023 form COBOL0900; MESSAGE/SEGMENT omitted, both written, INTO omitted, two operands, literal operand, NO DATA twice, WITH DATA before NO DATA, empty NO DATA, ON EXCEPTION, NOT ON EXCEPTION, stray END-RECEIVE all refused (COBOL5506/2269/2072/0306/0307); unended IF in NO DATA refused as not imperative (COBOL2796); DATA without WITH, SEGMENT INTO a group, nested RECEIVE with END-RECEIVE accepted. Witness refuses RECORD in place of MESSAGE (COBOL5506).

next.reason: 1985: "RECEIVE cd-name-1 { MESSAGE | SEGMENT } INTO identifier-1 [ NO DATA imperative-statement-1 ] [ WITH DATA ...]"; 2023: "RECEIVE FROM data-name-1 GIVING identifier-1 data-name-2 ... ON EXCEPTION: no cd-name, MESSAGE/SEGMENT or NO DATA phrase". 2023 drops the Communication module's cd-name RECEIVE. Its RECEIVE is a new message-tag statement with GIVING and ON EXCEPTION, not the 1985 format.
